name: The Harbour
note: Light every lantern. A tap switches its four neighbours too.

name: Twin Beacons
note: Two shores share the same tide. Overlapping pulses cancel.

name: Sounding Line
note: The two diamond relays send one extra pulse to each other.

name: Salt Gate
note: The barred station receives light. Switch it from a neighbour.

name: Open Water
note: A wider chart, the same tide. Hover to trace the next pulse.

name: The Narrows
note: Send light across the strait while the central gate is barred.

name: Northwatch
note: Two gates guard the crossing. Watch where the relay pulse lands.

name: Crescent Passage
note: Guide the last signal through the crescent and bring the fleet home.
